Dive into Bikini Bottom and dredge the depths to discover a bundle featuring characters, locations, scenes, and memes from SpongeBob SquarePants. • 1x Secret Lair x SpongeBob SquarePants: Legends of Bikini Bottom
• 1x Secret Lair x SpongeBob SquarePants: Internet Sensation
